title: Eternity
html_source: At this point in the novel, he has already contemplated all his sinful wrongdoing. Once he asks for forgiveness, he appears to be overwhelmed with holy energy. From then on, he has only emitted powerful positive religion that will likely result in an eternity in heaven. Aside from the character’s eternity, Joyce’s interpretation of art has been thoroughly spread and preserved by this (autobiographical novel).
